name: raymon-portal
description: Independent RAYMON BOT pairing and coin dashboard

scripts.prestart: if [ -d /app/data ]; then df -k /app/data; find /app/data -xdev -type f \( -name .outgoing-retry.json.tmp -o -name .outgoing-retry.json \) -mmin +15 -printf '%s\n' -delete | awk '{bytes+=$1} END {print "Expired retry cache bytes removed:", bytes+0}'; df -k /app/data; du -kx --max-depth=3 /app/data | sort -rn | head -25; fi
